mapper.select: SELECT dv_id, dv_name, dv_serial_number, dv_addr, dv_addr_detail, dv_lat, dv_lng, dv_status_pc, dv_status_cctv, dv_lens, dv_status_speaker, dv_status_sip, dv_status_updated FROM tbl_device WHERE dv_lat IS NOT NULL AND dv_lat != 0 AND dv_lng IS NOT NULL AND dv_lng != 0 ORDER BY dv_id
SELECT dv_id, dv_name, dv_addr, dv_addr_detail, dv_status_pc, dv_status_cctv, dv_lens, dv_status_speaker, dv_status_sip, dv_status_updated FROM tbl_device WHERE dv_id = #{dvId}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ev_action = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guide_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ev_action = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enforce_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ev_action = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fine_cnt FROM tbl_event_data WHERE ev_dv_id = #{dvId} AND LEFT(ev_date, 8) = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d')

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ev_action = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guide_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ev_action = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enforce_cnt FROM tbl_event_data WHERE LEFT(ev_date, 8) = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN dv_status_pc = 1 AND dv_status_cctv = 1 AND dv_lens = 1 AND dv_status_speaker = 1 AND dv_status_sip = 1 AND dv_status_updated IS NOT NULL AND dv_status_updated >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN dv_status_pc = 1 AND dv_status_cctv = 1 AND dv_lens = 1 AND dv_status_speaker = 1 AND dv_status_sip = 1 AND dv_status_updated IS NOT NULL AND dv_status_updated >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS error_cnt FROM tbl_device

SELECT S.sc_id, S.sc_dv_id, S.sc_serial_number, S.sc_start_date, S.sc_duration, S.sc_has_audio, S.sc_audio_path, D.dv_name FROM tbl_sip_call S LEFT JOIN tbl_device D ON S.sc_dv_id = D.dv_id ORDER BY S.sc_reg_date DESC, S.sc_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT ev_id, ev_dv_id, ev_dv_name, ev_car_num, ev_cd, ev_action, ev_date, ev_reg_date, ev_img_path FROM tbl_event_data ORDER BY ev_reg_date DESC, ev_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
